title: Pseudo-Anosov flow and dynamics on guts
summary: We relate the dynamics on a closed 3-manifold to the topological invariant, homology guts, proposed by Agol and Zhang. Given a closed manifold $M$ that admits a pseudo-Anosov flow $\varphi$ without perfect fits, we construct a canonical semiflow on the homology guts associated to homology classes carried by $\varphi$. We show that, up to orbit equivalent outside half annuli, the semiflow on the guts is invariant on each Thurston open cone.
